name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Helm lint
        run: |
          helm lint helm/falkordb-browser

  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Setup Kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          config: |
            kind: Cluster
            apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
            nodes:
              - role: control-plane
            networking:
              kubeProxyMode: "iptables"

      - name: Install chart into Kind
        run: |
          helm install test-release helm/falkordb-browser --namespace test --create-namespace
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falkordb-browser -n test --timeout=120s

      - name: Upload test artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b
        with:
          name: test-logs
          path: ./logs

  publish:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout helm-charts repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: helm-charts
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          YQ_VERSION="v4.40.5"
          YQ_SHA256="c1b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5
